scope: Site-wide H1s, hero subheads, service card lead, section copy and metadata for truelinefinishes.com (owner correction round 5, 19 Nov 2026)
literally: A painting and decorating business based in Baildon, Shipley, working on homes and business premises: interior painting, exterior painting, wallpapering, commercial work.
point_a: Someone in Baildon, Shipley, Guiseley, Ilkley or Otley is searching 'painter and decorator near me' with a room, a staircase or the front of the house that needs doing. They have been let down before by paint laid straight over old caulk and cracks, or by a decorator who never rang back. They are scanning for someone local who actually covers their town.
point_b: TrueLine Finishes does painting and decorating in my town, preparation is part of the price, it is insured, the quotation is free, and sending the details takes a minute.
offer: Free quotation on every job. No prices published. No guarantees, warranties or accreditations exist and none are claimed.
reviews: NONE SUPPLIED AS TEXT. Real Google reviews are displayed live through four Trustindex widgets keyed to the Google Business Profile (CID 8023434379390696838). The site is prohibited from writing reviews, a rating or a review count, so no review quote could be mined for copy.
competitor: Any other painter and decorator listing in Baildon, Shipley, Guiseley, Ilkley and Otley
operator_constraints: H1s must be grounded in the real service plus the verified service area, not questions and not owner-centric slogans (owner correction 5, item 3).
/services/ H1 must visibly carry 'Painting and Decorating' plus Baildon/Shipley.
Each service-detail H1 must carry its exact service keyword plus a verified location.
No self-work proof tropes ('does the work himself') in marketing headlines, cards or body; the brand leads, not the owner.
No full name in public marketing copy, SEO titles/descriptions or article teasers; legal identification pages keep it.
No prices, guarantees, warranties, accreditations, team claims, response times, review counts or ratings. 'Free quotation', never 'free quote'. No em dashes.
